labeller: Claude (AI), from the source PDF, per eval/answer_keys/README.md. Held-out set 4: labelled 26 Nov 2026 BEFORE any agent or second-reader run on this document, to test the new routing (amber/triage.py) on a datasheet nobody had seen.

labels.notes: Standby 2,000 kW / 2,500 kVA at 0.8 pf (p5; also p1).
Two standby ratings are listed, 277/480 V and 346/600 V, neither marked as supplied; 60 Hz stated (p1); 4-wire not stated.
7,709 skVA at 30% dip, 277/480 V, standard alternator K2112064N22 (p4 names it the standard model) >= 3000 kVA.
Standard excitation: permanent magnet (p4; p2 standard features).
16 cylinders, 4 cycle, turbocharged/intercooled (p4).
Electronic governor (p4); isochronous governor control (p2).
24 VDC system, solenoid-activated starter motor (p2): the 24 V starter, as the other keys judge R07.
163.4 gph at 100% standby load > 145 gph. The 330 gph figure is total fuel pump flow, not consumption.

Unit-mounted radiator (p4) and 122 F / 50 C max operating ambient (p5), but the 50 C cooling system is a configurable option (p3) and p5 gives data for both 40 C and 50 C packages: which is supplied is not stated.
EPA Tier 2 (p4); EPA Certified Stationary Emergency (every page).
Ambient before derate is referred to a bulletin; derate factors 'may apply' (p5): full rating at 122 F is not established.
Rated engine speed 1,800 rpm (p5).
4 poles (p4) and 2/3 pitch (p2) stated; brushless is not.
Class H rotor and stator (p4).
Anti-condensation heater is a configurable option, not marked, no voltage or phase.
A main line breaker is standard (p2); poles and trip type not stated; electronic trip is an option (p3).
Voltage regulation accuracy +/-0.5% (p4) <= 2%.
Tanks only 'if selected': the standard tank is UL 142 (p2), a UL2085 tank is an engineered option (p3), 24 h tanks are listed (p6); none is marked as supplied.
No jacket-water (coolant) heater rating anywhere; only 'coolant heater ball valves' as an option.
Enclosures and critical silencers are configurable options, not marked; rodent-proofing and silencer location not stated.
